ARCS kitMolecule 66give-get-table

Give Get Table

Show a time trade step by step: when, what the reader gives, what they get back, so the cost of their time sits beside its return.

States

Anatomy

#PartType roleToken (CSS variable)
1FrameSurface card, hairline border, rows split by hairlinessurface, border, ds-r-md
2Head rowMono uppercase label step on a tinted bar; the get column head in cyan; the when head is visually hiddensurface-2, muted, cyan
3WhenStep name, semiboldtext
4GiveWhat it costs them, secondary; several items stack as linestext-secondary
5GetWhat they receive, primarytext

Usage

Use it when

  • A proposal or plan where the reader's time is the real price and should be stated per step.
  • Each step has both a cost and a return; if one side is empty, it is a list, not this part.

Do not use it when

  • Do not put money here; price belongs in 41 Offer Close.
  • Do not exceed about five rows; past that it is a plan matrix (52).

Data it reads

FieldTypeRequiredNote
rows[]{when, give[], get}yesgive[] is one or more short lines.

Access

  • Marked up with role=table, row, rowheader, cell and columnheader, so a screen reader announces the columns.
  • On a phone the give and get cells carry visible text leads; the meaning never rests on colour or position.
  • Columns use minmax(0, 1fr); text wraps inside the cell.
